reason: On Linux x86_64 with uv 0.12.5 and Python 3.12.3, an isolated PEP 723 script containing `exclude-newer = "P7D"` and `exclude-newer-package = { ty = false }` reproduced the issue: `uv check --script script.py --show-version --preview-features=check-command` selected ty 0.0.70, while `uvx --no-config ty@latest --version` reported 0.0.73. A global-cutoff-only control also selected 0.0.70, whereas removing `[tool.uv]` selected 0.0.73, confirming the exemption had no effect.
